3
Wɔsoma Timoteo kɔ Tesalonika
1 # Aso 17.14-15 Enti yɛsɔ mu a na ɛnsɔ bio no, yɛpenee sɛ wɔnnya yɛn hɔ wɔ Atene. 2#Aso 16.1-3 Na yɛsomaa Timoteo a ɔyɛ yɛn nua ne yɛn yɔnko dwumayɛni ma Onyankopɔn wɔ Kristo asɛmpa mu, sɛ ɔmmɛhyɛ mo den na ɔntu mo fo mo gyidie ho, 3#Efe 3.13; 2 Ti 3.12 na amanehunu yi anha obiara, ɛfiri sɛ mo ara monim sɛ deɛ ɛtwa sɛ yɛhunu ara ne no. 4Na yɛwɔ mo nkyɛn no nso, yɛka kyerɛɛ mo ansa sɛ yɛbɛhunu amane, sɛdeɛ ɛbaeɛ na monim no. 5#Flp 2.16 Yei nti me nso, mesɔ mu a na ɛnsɔ bio no, mesomae, na mahunu mo gyidie mu, na amma sɛ ebia ɔsɔhwɛfoɔ no asɔ mo ahwɛ, ama yɛn mmɔdemmɔ adwuma no ayɛ ɔkwa.
Timoteo amanneɛbɔ
6 # Aso 18.5 Na afei Timoteo firii mo nkyɛn baa yɛn nkyɛn bɛkaa mo gyidie ne ɔdɔ ho asɛmpa, ne sɛ mokae yɛn yie daa, na mopɛ sɛ mohu yɛn sɛdeɛ yɛn nso yɛpɛ sɛ yɛhu mo kyerɛɛ yɛn no, 7yei nti, anuanom, mo gyidie ama yɛn werɛ akyekye wɔ mo ho, yɛn amanehunu ne ahohia nyinaa mu, 8ɛfiri sɛ, sɛ mogyina Awurade mu pintinn a, na yɛanya nkwa.
Paulo da Onyankopɔn ase
9Na aseda bɛn na yɛbɛtumi ada Onyankopɔn wɔ mo ho, anigyeɛ nyinaa a mo nti yɛn ani agye yɛn Nyankopɔn anim no ho? 10Awia ne anadwo yɛsrɛ pii sɛ yɛbɛhunu mo anim, na yɛama mo gyidie awie mayɛ.
Ɔsomafoɔ no srɛɛ adeɛ maa n’akenkanfoɔ no
11Na ɔno ara ankasa, yɛn Nyankopɔn ne Agya no, ne yɛn Awurade Yesu nnane yɛn kwan mmra mo nkyɛn. 12Na mo deɛ, Awurade mma monnɔɔso na mommoro so ɔdɔ a mode dodɔ mo ho mo ho ne nnipa nyinaa no mu, sɛdeɛ yɛn nso yɛdɔ mo no, 13#Flp 1.10 na wahyɛ mo akoma den a mo ho nni asɛm, kronkronyɛ mu, yɛn Nyankopɔn ne Agya anim, yɛn Awurade Yesu ne n’ahotefoɔ nyinaa ba mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Enti yɛsɔ mu a na ɛnsɔ bio no, yɛpenee sɛ wɔnnya yɛn hɔ wɔ Atene. Na yɛsomaa Timoteo a ɔyɛ yɛn nua ne yɛn yɔnko dwumayɛni ma Onyankopɔn wɔ Kristo asɛmpa mu, sɛ ɔmmɛhyɛ mo den na ɔntu mo fo mo gyidie ho, na amanehunu yi anha obiara, ɛfiri sɛ mo ara monim sɛ deɛ ɛtwa sɛ yɛhunu ara ne no. Na yɛwɔ mo nkyɛn no nso, yɛka kyerɛɛ mo ansa sɛ yɛbɛhunu amane, sɛdeɛ ɛbaeɛ na monim no. Yei nti me nso, mesɔ mu a na ɛnsɔ bio no, mesomae, na mahunu mo gyidie mu, na amma sɛ ebia ɔsɔhwɛfoɔ no asɔ mo ahwɛ, ama yɛn mmɔdemmɔ adwuma no ayɛ ɔkwa.

Na afei Timoteo firii mo nkyɛn baa yɛn nkyɛn bɛkaa mo gyidie ne ɔdɔ ho asɛmpa, ne sɛ mokae yɛn yie daa, na mopɛ sɛ mohu yɛn sɛdeɛ yɛn nso yɛpɛ sɛ yɛhu mo kyerɛɛ yɛn no, yei nti, anuanom, mo gyidie ama yɛn werɛ akyekye wɔ mo ho, yɛn amanehunu ne ahohia nyinaa mu, ɛfiri sɛ, sɛ mogyina Awurade mu pintinn a, na yɛanya nkwa.

Na aseda bɛn na yɛbɛtumi ada Onyankopɔn wɔ mo ho, anigyeɛ nyinaa a mo nti yɛn ani agye yɛn Nyankopɔn anim no ho? Awia ne anadwo yɛsrɛ pii sɛ yɛbɛhunu mo anim, na yɛama mo gyidie awie mayɛ.

Na ɔno ara ankasa, yɛn Nyankopɔn ne Agya no, ne yɛn Awurade Yesu nnane yɛn kwan mmra mo nkyɛn. Na mo deɛ, Awurade mma monnɔɔso na mommoro so ɔdɔ a mode dodɔ mo ho mo ho ne nnipa nyinaa no mu, sɛdeɛ yɛn nso yɛdɔ mo no, na wahyɛ mo akoma den a mo ho nni asɛm, kronkronyɛ mu, yɛn Nyankopɔn ne Agya anim, yɛn Awurade Yesu ne n’ahotefoɔ nyinaa ba mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
